per_bar_read.method: one scratchpad scan of the master: RMS per bar and per beat, bar = 240/68 = 3.5294 s, file bar n starts at 0.105 + 3.5294 n. The phase comes from the section cuts (cross-correlated to the master, r 0.995 to 1.000: intro cut = master 0.000 on, verse cut = master 84.812 on, chorus cut = master 197.753 on; both boundaries are bar lines of this grid, bars 24 and 56). Bar-level chroma shows ONE 4-bar chord cycle through the whole track (bar n matches bar n+4 at 0.97 to 1.00 inside a section, and bars 16, 24 and 40 match each other at 0.96 to 0.98), so every jump in this plan keeps the bar number modulo 4.
